decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the flagship of the firm's cloud messaging strategy and benefits from growing demand for automated digital communication.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction, although it faces strong competition from specialized capture vendors.
The fax optimization feature is cheap to maintain within the established fax business, which still serves regulated customers despite long-term decline.
Sandbox threat protection addresses rising ransomware and phishing threats and is a core part of the email security portfolio.
